title: The WASD keys steer the snake too
description: With a run live, pressing W, then A, then S, then D turns the snake upward, leftward, downward and rightward respectively.

steps.goal: On the Snake game, start a run if one is not already running. Then press the W key once and watch where the snake goes; then press A once and watch; then press S once and watch; then press D once and watch.
success: After pressing W the snake turned and moved upward
After pressing A the snake turned and moved leftward
After pressing S the snake turned and moved downward
After pressing D the snake turned and moved rightward
The game kept running smoothly with no error and no stuck board
